# Numerical filter validation (generated by scripts/filter_validation.py)

Measured on this machine (NumPy 2.5.3). 240 tone checks, **0 failures**. Gain = RMS(out)/RMS(in) on the central 50 % of a 4 s tone; `design dB` = |H(f)| of the designed SOS (x2 in dB for zero-phase). A check passes if passband gain is within 0.5 dB of 0 (or within 1 dB of the design near an edge) and stopband gain is at most the design value + 3 dB.
